papers.title: Finite element analysis of different subtrochanteric osteotomy techniques in total hip arthroplasty for high hip dislocation
papers.abstract: Aims Subtrochanteric shortening osteotomy in total hip arthroplasty (THA) for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) has variable outcomes. This study evaluated the initial stability of seven different osteotomy techniques. Methods A 3D finite element model of a femur with a stem was created. Seven models simulating osteotomies with different angles (0°, 45°, 90°, -90°, 120°, -120°, z-shaped) were analyzed. Outcomes included range of motion (ROM), bone/implant stress, and osteotomy surface separation. Results The 0° model had the greatest ROM (lowest stiffness). The z-shaped and -90° designs provided the best rotational stability. Analysis of the centre of rotation showed single-symmetric models (45°, z-shaped) shifted laterally, suggesting a ‘windshield wiper’ effect, while double-symmetric models (90°, -90°, 120°, -120°) stayed aligned with the prosthesis axis. Stress patterns differed: single-symmetric models concentrated stress on the lesser trochanter, while double-symmetric models stressed the greater trochanter, with a notable ring in the -90° design. Implant stresses were similar, except in the horizontal model. The -90° and 90° models had the least osteotomy separation, unlike the 45° model. Conclusion No single osteotomy technique outperformed others in all metrics. The z-shaped and -90° designs offered the best rotational stability; the -90° and 90° designs minimized axial separation; the 45° model showed the worst ‘windshield wiper’ effect. The 120° technique provided a balanced profile with moderate rotational stability, acceptable separation, and less pronounced stress rings, representing a reasonable compromise. The choice should be guided by clinical priorities. Cite this article: Bone Joint Res 2026;15(11):1364–1373.
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, Xijing Hospital of The Fourth Military Medical University, Xi’an, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文用有限元比较七种股骨转子下截骨术式对假体初始稳定性、骨/假体应力与截骨面分离的影响，直接涉及髋假体-股骨界面力学与初始稳定性。
llm.why_not_core: It focuses on osteotomy geometry in DDH THA and does not quantify Gruen-zone stress shielding, nor does it model interface micromotion with contact/friction or compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 高脱位DDH行THA时转子下截骨术式选择缺乏力学依据。
summary_zh.method: 建立带假体股骨三维有限元模型，比较七种截骨角度的ROM、应力与截骨面分离。
summary_zh.result: z形与-90°旋转稳定性最佳，-90°与90°轴向分离最小，120°综合表现均衡。
summary_zh.validation: 仅基于单一三维有限元模型的仿真对比，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: The optimal subtrochanteric shortening osteotomy geometry in THA for high hip dislocation remains mechanically undetermined.
summary_en.method: A three-dimensional finite element femur-with-stem model was used to compare seven osteotomy configurations in terms of range of motion, bone and implant stress, and osteotomy surface separation.
summary_en.result: Z-shaped and -90° designs gave the best rotational stability, -90° and 90° minimized axial separation, and the 120° design offered a balanced compromise.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to comparative simulation on a single finite element model without experimental corroboration.

papers.title: K/Ce/Sm multiple-doped CaBi 2 Nb 2 O 9 aurivillius-type ceramics used for high-temperature piezoelectric ultrasonic transducer
papers.abstract: Abstract Aurivillius-type CaBi2Nb2O9 (CBN) is attractive for high-temperature ultrasonic sensing owing to its high Curie temperature (TC ≈ 940 ℃). However, its weak piezoelectric response and loss of polarization alignment during thermal exposure limit its practical performance. Herein, K/Ce/Sm co-substitution at the Ca site was employed to modify the lattice structure, electrical transport, and domain morphology of CBN ceramics. Co-substitution reduced the orthorhombic distortion while preserving the orthorhombic framework. The optimized CBN-KCS-12 ceramic exhibited a piezoelectric coefficient d33 of 18 pC/N, a TC of approximately 933 ℃, and a ρdc resistivity of 2.59 × 106 Ω·cm at 650 ℃, approximately 18.5 times that of undoped CBN. The annealing temperature corresponding to 50% retention of the initial d₃₃ increased from 600 to 850 ℃, and CBN-KCS-12 retained approximately 44% of its initial d33 after annealing at 900 ℃. Piezoresponse force microscopy revealed larger block-like regions in CBN-KCS-12 compared with the fine stripe-like patterns in undoped CBN, with block-like contrast also observed after annealing at 900 ℃. The elastic modulus also increased from 30.1 to 33.8 GPa. Finally, a single-element ultrasonic transducer fabricated from CBN-KCS-12 produced clear pulse-echo signals from room temperature to 400 ℃, achieving a signal-to-noise ratio above 36 dB and a -6 dB fractional bandwidth of approximately 42% at 400 °C. These results demonstrate the potential of multi-element A-site co-substitution for improving CBN ceramics for high-temperature ultrasonic applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究高温压电陶瓷用于超声换能器，与增材制造生物医学材料及骨科植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports Aurivillius piezoelectric ceramics for high-temperature ultrasonic transducers and contains no additive manufacturing, no porous implant architecture, no stress shielding or osseointegration assessment, and no biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升CaBi2Nb2O9陶瓷压电性能与热稳定性以用于高温超声传感。
summary_zh.method: 在Ca位进行K/Ce/Sm共掺杂，调控晶格畸变、电导与畴结构。
summary_zh.result: d33达18 pC/N，居里温度约933℃，900℃退火后保留约44%压电活性，换能器400℃信噪比超36 dB。
summary_zh.validation: 压电力显微镜、电学与压电测试及换能器脉冲回波实验。

summary_en.motivation: Aurivillius CaBi2Nb2O9 ceramics suffer from weak piezoelectric response and depolarization at elevated temperatures, limiting high-temperature ultrasonic sensing.
summary_en.method: K/Ce/Sm co-substitution at the Ca site was used to tune lattice distortion, electrical transport, and domain morphology of CBN ceramics.
summary_en.result: The optimized composition achieved d33 of 18 pC/N, TC near 933 C, and retained about 44% of initial d33 after 900 C annealing, enabling a transducer with over 36 dB SNR at 400 C.
summary_en.validation: Piezoresponse force microscopy, electrical and piezoelectric measurements, and pulse-echo testing of a fabricated single-element transducer.

papers.title: Aprendizagem significativa e crítica no ensino de matemática: uma prática pedagógica com base na escala de proficiência do SAEB
papers.abstract: This experience report presents a pedagogical practice conducted with students aged 11–12 years to foster meaningful learning in mathematics, focusing on the concept of area. The proposal was grounded in the Theory of Critical Meaningful Learning and employed active learning methodologies that encouraged participation, inquiry, and reflection. The teaching strategy was informed by the proficiency scale of Brazil’s National Basic Education Assessment System (SAEB), aligning classroom activities with the competencies assessed. The results indicate that integrating data from large-scale educational assessments with contextualized teaching practices improved students’ performance and strengthened meaningful learning. The findings suggest that combining educational theory with classroom practice and using assessment indicators to guide instruction can enhance Mathematics teaching and foster critical and meaningful learning.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文是小学数学教学实践报告，与FEA代理建模、仿真采样效率、不确定性量化及植入物生物力学设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a mathematics education experience report with no simulation, surrogate modeling, optimization, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics content.

summary_zh.method: 基于批判性有意义学习理论，结合SAEB熟练度量表设计主动学习教学活动。
summary_zh.result: 学生成绩提升，有意义学习得到加强。
summary_zh.validation: 课堂实践的经验报告，无对照实验或定量建模验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to promote meaningful learning of the area concept among primary school students by linking classroom instruction to large-scale assessment indicators.
summary_en.method: An active-learning pedagogical intervention was designed around the SAEB proficiency scale and grounded in Critical Meaningful Learning theory.
summary_en.result: Students' performance improved and meaningful learning was reportedly strengthened.
summary_en.validation: The work is an experience report based on classroom practice, without controlled experiments or quantitative modeling.
